title: @xtr-dev/changelog config
description: changelog.config.json, or the "changelog" key in package.json. Function options (customBump, formatter) are only available in JS configs.

bumpMode.description: semver: type → level via bumpMap. commit-count: one patch per commit. custom: customBump (JS configs only).

initialVersion.description: Version to start from when nothing records one yet.

prerelease.description: Cut pre-releases with this identifier (e.g. beta → 1.3.0-beta.0).

bumpMinorPreMajor.description: While the major version is 0, breaking changes bump the minor version.

bumpMap.description: Commit type → bump level (semver mode). Merged over the defaults. Breaking changes always bump major.

includeTypes.description: Only these commit types count (null = all).

excludeTypes.description: Commit types that never count (applied after includeTypes).

groups.description: Output groups, in markdown order. Replaces the defaults.

repositoryUrl.description: Base URL used for links in the markdown. Detected from package.json#repository or the origin remote when unset; false disables links.

releaseCommitMessage.description: Release commit message; {version} is substituted. Matching commits never count toward a release.

paths.description: Only count commits touching these paths (relative to the working directory). For monorepo packages.
